# monarch

monarch provides tools to find and keep track of contact info and social
media handles of rOpenSci community members.

monarch is in very early development.

## Installation

You can install the development version of monarch like so:

``` r

pak::pkg_install("ropensci-org/monarch")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(monarch)
socials_fetch(github = "steffilazerte")
#> Fetching socials from GitHub account
#> Fetching socials from rOpenSci Author pages
#> Mastodon handle already present
#>       type                        value        github
#> 1   github                steffilazerte steffilazerte
#> 2     name               Steffi LaZerte steffilazerte
#> 3 mastodon @steffilazerte@fosstodon.org steffilazerte
#> 4 linkedin               steffi-lazerte steffilazerte
#> 5  twitter               @steffilazerte steffilazerte
#> 6  website             steffilazerte.ca steffilazerte
#> 7    email         sel@steffilazerte.ca steffilazerte
#> 8    orcid          0000-0002-7690-8360 steffilazerte
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_handles()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/monarch/reference/add_handles.md)
  : Find and insert missing social media handles
- [`cache_check()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/monarch/reference/cache_check.md)
  : Check Cached Dir
- [`cocoon_fetch()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/monarch/reference/cocoon_fetch.md)
  : Fetch all details on a social contact
- [`cocoon_open()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/monarch/reference/cocoon_open.md)
  : Load socials data from local file
- [`cocoon_remove()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/monarch/reference/cocoon_remove.md)
  : Remove Socials by GitHub handle
- [`cocoon_update()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/monarch/reference/cocoon_update.md)
  : Save/Update socials data to local file
- [`fetch()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/monarch/reference/fetch.md) :
  Fetch a value
- [`fmt_masto()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/monarch/reference/fmt_masto.md)
  : Convert a mastodon user link to handle
- [`gh_search()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/monarch/reference/gh_search.md)
  : Find GH username from repository and full name
- [`local_eg()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/monarch/reference/local_eg.md)
  : Detect if running examples locally
- [`masto2user()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/monarch/reference/masto2user.md)
  : Convert a mastodon user link to handle
- [`socials_fetch()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/monarch/reference/socials_fetch.md)
  : Fetch contact information from social media
- [`socials_gh()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/monarch/reference/socials_gh.md)
  : Fetch contact information from GitHub
- [`socials_masto()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/monarch/reference/socials_masto.md)
  : Fetch Mastodon handle
- [`socials_ro()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/monarch/reference/socials_ro.md)
  : Fetch contact information from rOpenSci author pages
- [`socials_update()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/monarch/reference/socials_update.md)
  : Update a socials data frame with new values
